items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: Dave Stewart and Ernie could put them out.

ctx.x: Well, he made it for the same bunch, the boys that were taking it. They had him down there, and he thought they were going to issue him very soon, but of course they never did get issued until they got out to the Pacific. They never did carry them out there, and Dave Stewart and Ernie could put them out. Mm-hmm.
Well, Roy, isn't there some story that they...where did he make those? At the US Recording Studio here?
